title: DOE SRT and NNSA Office of Secure Transportation move recovered UFO material between labs

tellings.quote: operations. The DOE and/NSA employ two other agencies I think are highly likely involved in UFO retrieval operations or passing recovered UFO materials between US national labs here in the continental United States.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels about two units inside the Department of Energy, the federal agency that runs America's nuclear work: a security unit he calls SRT, and the Office of Secure Transportation, which belongs to the department's nuclear weapons agency. UAPGerb says he thinks these two are very likely involved in recovering crashed UFOs or moving recovered UFO material between the government's national science labs in the continental United States. If true, it would mean the government quietly ships such material around the country.
